test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 03
subject: general
question: Eight people A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table. A and B are facing towards the center while the other six people are facing opposite the center. A is sitting second to the right of H. B sits third to the left of A. D sits second to the right of G. G is neither an immediate neighbour of B nor A. E and F are immediate neighbours and are facing outside. What is the position of C with respect to D?
solution: Eight people: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H People who are facing the inward direction = A, B People who are facing the outward direction = C, D, E, F, G, and H 1) A is sitting second to the right of H. As it is a circular arrangement, we can randomly pick a seat for H and then we can place accordingly. 2) B sits third to the left of A. It implies, B is sitting third to the left of H. Also, now that we have identified the seats of A and B, we can safely mark other seats as outward-facing seats.
